resources.name: Sage
resources.description: Pick medicinal sage from the dry prairie. Supplies Herbal Remedies.

resources.name: Wild Herbs
resources.description: Gather the useful plants growing along the trail. Supplies Trail Medicine.

resources.name: Silver Ore
resources.description: Work the exposed silver veins for Silver Strike.

resources.name: Coal
resources.description: Gather loose coal for Fuel for the Forge.

resources.name: Dynamite
resources.description: Carefully recover a stick from the abandoned supply caches. Repeat after the gathering cooldown to finish Explosive Situation.

scavengers-reach.description: Pick through the wreck piles for real robot parts. Common scrap can patch an injured robot; recovered circuitry, motors and cores supply the existing robot recipes.

resources.name: Scrap Metal
resources.description: Loose hull offcuts and brackets from the foreground wreckage. Build a Service Droid or spend a piece to repair a robot.

resources.name: Shiny Bits
resources.description: Small polished fittings among the dust and scrap. Each bit can restore 8 HP to an injured robot.

resources.name: Salvage Wiring
resources.description: Usable cable pulled from a broken chassis. Spare wiring can repair an injured robot or other mechanical gear.

resources.name: Droid Component
resources.description: A serviceable mechanism recovered from a discarded droid. Keep it as a spare part for robot repairs.

resources.name: Circuit Board
resources.description: Intact circuitry inside a ruined control box. Every robot recipe needs boards, and a board can restore 16 HP to an injured robot.

resources.name: Servo Motor
resources.description: A working joint motor salvaged from a frame. Used by all four robot recipes and accepted as a repair part.

resources.name: Power Cell
resources.description: An intact rechargeable cell from the ship debris. Powers Service Droids, Repair Bots and Medical Assistance Drones.

resources.name: Metal Plating
resources.description: A recoverable protective panel from a wrecked hull. Armor a Combat Droid or use the plating for robot repairs.

resources.name: AI Chip
resources.description: A rare intact controller found in the deeper machinery. One chip is required to build each of the four robot companions.

resources.name: Neural Core
resources.description: A delicate processing core protected inside an old chassis. It completes the Medical Assistance Drone recipe.

resources.name: Weapon System
resources.description: A surviving integrated weapons assembly from a military wreck. Needed for a Combat Droid; it is a crafting part, not a usable weapon by itself.

resources.name: Rare Component
resources.description: An uncommon precision part tucked inside the wreckage. Two are needed for a Combat Droid, and other advanced recipes also use them.

notes.yield: Range of items gathered on success
notes.tool_bonus: Item that gives +2 to gathering checks for this category
